marketplace.name: headcount
marketplace.description: An agent organization structured as a C-suite hierarchy. Each department installs independently so only the relevant function loads.

departments.title: Office of the CEO
departments.description: Direction, capital and attention allocation, cross-functional arbitration, strategy validation, and the method for structuring the organization itself.

departments.title: Technology
departments.description: Architecture, engineering delivery, development discipline, debugging, review, and AI and automation systems.

departments.title: Security
departments.description: Threat modeling, security architecture review, incident response, vulnerability management, and access and identity. Reviewer-class: blocking findings are not overrulable by the department under review.

departments.title: IT Operations
departments.description: Corporate IT: service desk, systems and network administration, endpoints, assets, identity lifecycle, and backup and recovery.

departments.title: Product
departments.description: Product strategy, UX and usability audit, design systems, interface craft, brand expression, and visual direction.

departments.title: Marketing
departments.description: Positioning, content strategy and production, social and video, brand voice, copywriting, PR, and partnerships.

departments.title: Demand Generation
departments.description: Organic and paid acquisition, conversion, measurement, experimentation, lifecycle messaging, and distribution.

departments.title: Revenue
departments.description: Outbound, sales enablement, revenue operations, pricing and packaging, activation, retention, and referrals.

departments.title: Finance
departments.description: Financial modeling, budgeting and forecasting, unit economics, and financial decision support.

departments.title: Operations
departments.description: Program management, process design, vendor and supplier management, and operational delivery.

departments.title: Program Management Office
departments.description: Enterprise program management office: portfolio governance, program and project delivery, dependencies and delivery risk, benefits realization, and adoption.

departments.title: Customer Experience
departments.description: Support operations, escalation management, voice of customer, and self-service. Owns what the customer experiences after the sale.

departments.title: Data & Analytics
departments.description: Data governance, warehouse and semantic modeling, business intelligence, and AI/ML governance.

departments.title: Corporate Strategy
departments.description: Portfolio strategy, corporate development, strategic alliances, and scenario planning.

departments.title: People
departments.description: Org design, hiring and interviewing, compensation and leveling, and workforce planning.

departments.title: Legal & Risk
departments.description: Contract review, privacy and data protection, enterprise risk, corporate governance, compliance, and audit readiness. Reviewer-class: its findings are not overrulable by the department under review.
